2: A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
3: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
4: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
5: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
6: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
7: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
8: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
9: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
10: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
11: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
12: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
13: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
14: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
